name: National University of Singapore
summary: Singapore's national research university, founded in 1905, with campuses at Kent Ridge, Bukit Timah and Outram. International applicants with IB, A-Level, CBSE/ISC and other qualifications apply through the Office of Admissions and are assessed holistically, with no fixed minimum grades published.

internationalShare.notes: Published as 'more than a third hailing from overseas'; nearly 100 nationalities in student body.

applicationPlatform.value: NUS Office of Admissions online application
applicationPlatform.notes: Official page content was retrieved via search-result excerpts (nus.edu.sg is blocked for direct fetch in this environment); wording follows the excerpt of the official page.

applicationFee.value: S$20 (international students with international qualifications); S$10 for other applicants
applicationFee.notes: Non-refundable, GST inclusive, per application (except Music). Academic year the fee applies to not confirmed. Official page content was retrieved via search-result excerpts (nus.edu.sg is blocked for direct fetch in this environment); wording follows the excerpt of the official page.

testing.notes: Not required for CBSE/ISC applicants (also AP, ACT with Writing). For A-Level, NUS states SAT/ACT is not required with completed A-Level results but is required if exams are completed after the application closing date. Not required for IB Diploma applicants who apply on predicted results. Confirm current-year rule on NUS pages.
ACT with Writing; same conditions as SAT.

internationalTuition.notes: NUS publishes AY2026/27 undergraduate fee tables (subsidised fees for international students receiving the MOE Tuition Grant, and non-subsidised fees) at the NUS Registrar PDF (s9), but the figures could not be read reliably here and search excerpts conflicted, so none are recorded. MOE Tuition Grant (s10, s18): international students who accept the grant are bonded to work for a Singapore entity for 3 years after graduation; liquidated damages (the subsidy plus interest) apply if breached.

domesticTuition.notes: Domestic (Singapore citizen/PR) fees not recorded; see NUS Registrar fee table.

scholarships.name: NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of all countries except Singapore with strong leadership potential, outstanding co-curricular records and outstanding high-school results, applying to a full-time NUS undergraduate degree. Transfer applicants not eligible.
scholarships.coverage: 100% of subsidised tuition (after MOE Tuition Grant), S$5,800 annual living allowance, S$1,750 one-time computer allowance, S$5,000 annual accommodation allowance

opportunities.name: NUS Overseas Colleges (NOC)
opportunities.description: Half- or full-year internships at start-ups in global entrepreneurial hubs (e.g. Silicon Valley, Beijing, Stockholm) while taking courses at partner universities.

opportunities.name: Undergraduate Research Opportunities Programme (UROP)
opportunities.description: Undergraduates in Computing and other faculties undertake supervised research for credit.

opportunities.name: Student Exchange Programme
opportunities.description: Exchange study at over 180 partner universities worldwide.
